title: Trade intent (trade-intent/1)
description: A signal forwarded by algo_scalper_api to options-trading-agent over the pull endpoint `GET /api/trade_intents?after=<cursor>&mode=<mode>` (operator token). Deliberately a SIGNAL, not an order: strike, quantity, stop, target and order type are absent - the agent decides all of them (its ADR-004 mandatory bracket stays intact). The poll response wraps intents in an envelope documented in contracts/README.md (cursor + control block with circuit-breaker state, intake_enabled and server_time).

intent_id.description: Idempotency key. A repeated id is acknowledged as 'duplicate' and never re-processed.

expires_at.description: Default TTL 20 s. The agent drops late intents with code INTENT_EXPIRED, on receipt and again at submit.

mode.description: live requires explicit human promotion (LIVE_TRADING_ACK on the agent side).

direction.description: BULLISH -> long CE, BEARISH -> long PE (buy-to-open only).

signal_id.description: Rails strategy_signals row id, for traceability.

spot_hint.description: Spot at signal time, informational only. The agent always re-reads its own feed.
